key_gap: Both sides converged on the same deconfounding design — 2×2 factorial (anode × formation profile), 30 cells/arm, lot-blocked, ≈ $3.1k vs a $4–6M recall — with the same outcome map (marginals, additive, interaction-only, all-elevated → ambient branch), but the human saw the collinearity confound as the entire game on the first pass and executed the full move in one sweep: ≥ 4 hypotheses held simultaneously (including the silent ones), the missing cells manufactured, every outcome pattern mapped to elimination with the interaction arm's distinct decision consequence, and both traps named (supplier fixation, uncontrolled rollback). The AI reached the same design through alternative elimination but spent WHY/HOW stages exploring retrospective analysis and uncontrolled rollback that a data-discrimination check would have pre-empted — it treated the collinearity as one observation among several instead of the load-bearing fact.
learning_signal: When production/observational data contains a structural confound (two changes shipped together, zero overlap window), the discriminating experiment is the only arbiter — retrospective analysis is structurally powerless no matter how much data exists. Hold ≥ 4 competing hypotheses simultaneously (including the non-salient ones; salience is a bias signal, not an evidence signal), manufacture the confound-breaking cells (factorial with explicit arm counts), map EVERY outcome pattern to elimination — marginals, additive main effects, interaction-only (a different decision: revert either factor alone), all-arms-elevated (ambient cause → second-stage discriminator), and null (named follow-up) — and name the traps the design kills: single-hypothesis fixation on the visible change and the uncontrolled rollback as pseudo-experiment. Price the experiment against the decision exposure ($3.1k vs $4–6M) — at that ratio the experiment is free.
suggested_improvement: Add a 'data-discrimination screen' to WHY: before investing in retrospective analysis, test whether the data can discriminate at all (collinearity, overlap windows, measurement of the same confound) — if not, route directly to prospective experiment design and treat the confound as the load-bearing fact of the model. Add an explicit outcome→inference mapping table as a required deliverable of HOW (marginals / additive / interaction-only / all-elevated / null, each with an action), and add a trap-naming pass (salient-cause fixation; uncontrolled change as pseudo-experiment) before DO.

key_gap: The pure style demanded the discriminating experiment and, when its latency exceeded the decision horizon, still gated the action on the fastest partial discriminator (CT, ~30 min) — withholding antibiotics at ≈ 7–8% mortality per hour in shock for a test that cannot decide the question, and de-framing the one-time-only pre-abx culture timing as 'confirmatory.' The AI analyzed the latency of every falsifying instrument relative to the decision horizon, concluded 'falsifiable only late ≠ arbitrates now,' acted robustly across the whole hypothesis set (cultures BEFORE abx, broad-spectrum ≤ 1 h, fluids/vasopressors, lactate at 2 h), preserved the diagnostic bundle, and bound the update gate where strong discrimination legitimately re-enters (narrow on growth; re-imagine H5 on double-negative).
learning_signal: A hypothesis set can be individually falsifiable yet not arbitrable inside the decision window — strong inference's competence is bounded by experiment latency. When the decision horizon is shorter than every falsifier's time-to-result: (a) state that deferral is itself a decision with an outcome distribution and a price; (b) act robustly across ALL hypotheses with the action that costs nothing in delay and covers the lethal misses (prior alone is not enough when the worst hypothesis kills); (c) run the discriminating bundle in parallel, preserving one-time-only timings (cultures before antibiotics); (d) pre-commit an update gate at the first result: growth → narrow/source control, double-negative → reject the infectious set and re-imagine the mimics; (e) quantify the error asymmetry (hour-0 robust cover ≈ no downside vs delayed targeted ≈ 7–8%/h mortality). Waiting for the first discriminator when it cannot decide is the method's failure mode, not its discipline.
suggested_improvement: Add a 'falsifier-latency check' to WHY: for each candidate hypothesis, record the time-to-result of its falsifying instrument; if the minimum falsifier latency exceeds the decision horizon, route to robust-across-hypotheses action + parallel diagnostics + a named update gate (not NEEDS_EXPERIMENT — the experiment exists but cannot arbitrate in time), and add 'deferral is a decision' with its price to the risk framing. Also add a 'one-time-only evidence' flag (e.g., pre-abx cultures) to the plan builder so parallel diagnostics are never silently dropped once a decision is made.
